paragraphs.en: The next morning, we began work early to transport the gold. Three men remained on the island, but a single lookout on the hill was enough to keep them at bay. The task was daunting—nearly a mile by land and three miles by boat to the HISPANIOLA—but we pushed forward briskly.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，我们就着手搬运黄金。岛上留下了三个人，但山顶上一个瞭望哨已经足够让他们安心留守。这项任务艰巨异常——陆地行进近一英里，再乘船航行三英里才能抵达HISPANIOLA号——但我们还是迅速行动起来，毫不松懈。

paragraphs.en: Gray and Ben Gunn handled the boat while others piled treasure on the beach. Each bar of gold, slung in a rope's end, was heavy but manageable. I spent my days packing the coins into bread-bags in the cave, sorting through English, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Georges, Louises, doubloons, and more.
paragraphs.zh: 格雷和本·古恩负责划船，其他人则把财宝堆在沙滩上。每一根装有金币的绳子都很沉，但还算好搬。我每天都在洞穴里把这些硬币塞进面包袋中，仔细地将英磅、法郎、西班牙比索、葡萄牙埃斯库多、路易金币和双倍金币等货币分类整理。

paragraphs.en: The collection was vast and varied, giving me great pleasure.
paragraphs.zh: 这个收藏种类繁多，给我带来了极大的愉悦。

paragraphs.en: Day after day, we worked tirelessly, stowing fortunes aboard each evening. Yet, we heard nothing of the three surviving mutineers until one night, when the doctor and I were walking on the hill overlooking the island's lowlands. A strange noise, a mix of shrieking and singing, drifted up from below.
paragraphs.zh: 日复一日，我们辛勤工作，每天晚上都将财宝装载上船。然而直到有一天夜晚，医生和我漫步在俯瞰岛屿低地的山坡上时，才听到了三个幸存叛乱者发出的奇怪声音——那是一阵混杂着尖叫声与歌声的声音，从下面飘了上来。

paragraphs.en: "Heaven forgive them," said the doctor. "It must be the mutineers."
paragraphs.zh: “但愿天怜他们，”医生说道，“一定是叛乱者。”

paragraphs.en: "Drunk, sir," replied Silver, appearing behind us.
paragraphs.zh: “酒鬼先生，”银狐从我们身后答道。

paragraphs.en: Silver continued to act as if he were still a valued member of our group, despite daily rejections. He persistently tried to win over everyone with his politeness, though none treated him better than Ben Gunn or myself. I had seen Silver planning another betrayal on the plateau, which made me view him even more negatively.
paragraphs.zh: Silver 继续装作仍是我们团队中的一员，尽管每天都遭到拒绝。他坚持不懈地用礼貌来博取大家的好感，但没有人比本·古恩或我对他更好。我在高原上亲眼目睹了 Silver 另一次背叛的计划，这让我对他的看法更加负面。

paragraphs.en: "Drunk or raving," said the doctor gruffly.
paragraphs.zh: “醉了还是疯了，”医生粗声粗气地说。

paragraphs.en: "Right you were, sir," replied Silver. "And precious little odds between us."
paragraphs.zh: “您说对了，先生，”锡尔弗回答，“我们之间其实并没有多大差别。”

paragraphs.en: The doctor sneered and said, "I suppose you wouldn't call me a humane man, Master Silver? But if I was sure they were raving—certainly one is down with fever—I would leave this camp and risk my life to help them."
paragraphs.zh: 医生冷笑道：“难道你不认为我是个仁慈的人，赛勒斯先生？不过如果确定他们只是发疯——当然，也许他们是发烧了——我会离开这个营地，冒着生命危险去救他们。”

paragraphs.en: "Ask your pardon, sir," Silver responded. "You'd lose your life. I'm on your side now; I wouldn't wish for the party to be weakened, let alone you.
paragraphs.zh: “請原諒，先生，”辛格利回应道，“您會喪命的。我现在站在您的這邊；我可不希望團體的力量被削弱，更別說是您了。”

paragraphs.en: These men couldn’t keep their word—no matter how much they wanted to—and they couldn’t believe in your skills."
paragraphs.zh: 这些男人食言而肥，无论他们多么想遵守诺言，也始终无法信任你的能力。

paragraphs.en: "No," said the doctor. "You're the man who keeps his word."
paragraphs.zh: “不，”医生说道，“你才是那个言出必行的人。”

paragraphs.en: We heard a gunshot far away and assumed the pirates were hunting. A council was held, deciding we must desert them on the island. Ben Gunn was delighted, and Gray strongly approved.
paragraphs.zh: 我们听到了远处传来的枪声，以为海盗们在打猎。于是大家商议决定，我们必须弃他们于岛上了。本·古恩一听乐了，格雷也极力赞同。

paragraphs.en: We left behind powder and shot, salt goat meat, medicines, tools, clothing, a spare sail, rope, and tobacco as per the doctor's request.
paragraphs.zh: 我们按照医生的要求留下了火药和子弹、盐渍羊肉、药品、工具、衣物、备用帆布、绳索以及烟草。

paragraphs.en: We had secured the treasure and provisioned ourselves well. On a fine morning, we weighed anchor from North Inlet, flying the same colors as our captain had used in battle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们已经获得了宝藏，并且准备充分。在一个晴朗的早晨，我们在北港卸下了锚，船上的旗帜与船长在战斗中使用的相同。

paragraphs.en: As we navigated through the narrows, we noticed three men kneeling on a sand spit, their arms raised in supplication. Despite our sympathy, we could not risk another mutiny or spare them by taking them home for execution. The doctor called out to them, informing them of the supplies left behind and where they could find them.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们穿梭在狭窄的航道中时，注意到三名男子跪在一片沙洲上，双臂高举，似乎在乞求什么。尽管我们心生同情，但还是不敢冒险再发生叛变，也不能将他们带回家执行死刑。医生喊了声，告诉他们船上的补给品存放位置以及如何找到它们。

paragraphs.en: Seeing us continue on course, one man leapt up, firing a shot over Silver's head and through the main-sail. We hid under the bulwarks as they disappeared from sight.
paragraphs.zh: 见我们继续前行，一人跳起，一枪从Silver头顶越过，穿透了主帆。我们躲在船舷下，眼睁睁看着他们消失不见。

paragraphs.en: By noon, we had passed the highest rock of Treasure Island, its outline fading into the sea. With a shortage of men, everyone aboard was needed; only the captain rested in the stern, giving orders while recovering but still needing peace.
paragraphs.zh: 到中午时分，我们已经驶过了藏宝岛上的最高岩石，它的轮廓渐渐消失在海平线下。由于人手不足，船上每个人都各司其职；只有船长在船尾稍作休息，但仍需发出指令，寻求片刻安宁。

paragraphs.en: We headed for the nearest port in Spanish America due to insufficient crew and challenging weather, reaching it exhausted after several days at sea.
paragraphs.zh: 由于船员不足且天气恶劣，我们前往了西班牙美洲最近的港口，在海上航行数日后疲惫不堪地抵达。

paragraphs.en: At sunset, our ship anchored in a picturesque gulf surrounded by shore boats filled with Negroes and Mexican Indians. We disembarked to explore the town, where we met the captain of an English warship. The doctor and squire spent the evening on his ship, enjoying their company.
paragraphs.zh: 夕阳时分，我们的船只停泊在一处风景如画的海湾中，四周是挤满了黑人和墨西哥土著人的岸边小船。我们下船探索小镇，在此遇到了一艘英国军舰的船长。医生和乡绅当晚留在了那艘军舰上，享受着与船员们的相聚时光。

paragraphs.en: Ben Gunn was alone on deck when we returned. He confessed that Silver had escaped in a shore boat earlier, claiming it was to save our lives from the man with one leg. However, Ben also admitted that the sea cook had taken some coins, about three or four hundred guineas, by cutting through a bulkhead unnoticed.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们返回时，本·古恩独自一人在甲板上。他承认银狐早些时候乘岸上的小船逃走了，说是为保住我们不受单腿人的伤害。然而，本也坦白说，那名大副厨师偷偷拿走了一些硬币，大约三四百英镑，是通过切割隔舱板未被察觉的方式得手的。

paragraphs.en: We were relieved to be rid of Silver so easily. After securing a few hands, we set sail and arrived in Bristol just as Mr. Blandly was preparing another ship. Only five of our original crew members returned with the HISPANIOLA; the rest had perished due to drink and other misfortunes, though not quite as badly off as the ship they sang about:
paragraphs.zh: 我们轻易摆脱了Silver，松了一口气。在稳固了几根缆绳后，我们起航前往布里斯托尔，恰巧Mr. Blandly正在准备另一艘船。只有五名原船员随HISPANIOLA返回；其余人因酗酒和其他不幸相继离世，虽然情况没有他们所唱的那么糟糕。

paragraphs.en: With one man of her crew alive, What put to sea with seventy-five.
paragraphs.zh: 仅存一个船员生还，当初出海时却有七十五人。

paragraphs.en: Captain Smollett has retired from his naval career. Gray, having saved and wisely invested his treasure, is now a mate and part owner of a fine ship, married with children. Ben Gunn, on the other hand, squandered his reward in just nineteen days, returning to beggary by the twentieth.
paragraphs.zh: 斯莫莱特船长已经退出了海军生涯。格雷在节省并明智地投资了他的财富之后，如今已成为一艘漂亮船只的大副兼部分船主，并且已婚有子。而本·古恩则在仅仅十九天内挥霍掉了他的奖赏，在第二十天便重返贫困。

paragraphs.en: No news of Silver; he has vanished from my life entirely. Yet I imagine he met his old companion and perhaps still enjoys comfort with her and Captain Flint. I hope so, for his chances elsewhere are slim.
paragraphs.zh: 银狐音信全无，仿佛从我的生活中彻底消失了。但我想象着他遇到了那位老朋友，并且或许仍在她那里享受着安逸的生活，与弗林特船长也保持着联系。但愿如此，因为他在其他地方的机会渺茫。

paragraphs.en: The buried treasure and weapons remain where Flint hid them, untouched. Oxen and wagons could not persuade me back to that cursed island; the worst nightmares come when I hear the sea's roar or Captain Flint’s voice echoing in my dreams: "Pieces of eight!"
paragraphs.zh: 宝藏和武器依旧留在弗林特藏匿的地方，原封未动。牛群和马车都无法说服我重返那个该死的岛屿；每当海浪的轰鸣声或船长弗林特的声音在我梦中回响时，我才意识到那才是最可怕的噩梦：“八便士一片！”
